description_en: Retrieves user information from an enterprise Active Directory (AD) when you use an AD directory to connect to your enterprise AD
description_zh: 如果您使用AD目录来对接企业自有AD，调用该接口可以获取企业AD中的用户信息
kebab_example: aliyun ecd list-directory-users --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --directory-id cn-hangzhou+dir-jedbpr4sl9l370000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDirectoryUsers

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The fuzzy match query string. All results that contain this character string are returned
parameters.help_zh: 模糊查询字符串。包含该字符串的结果都将被匹配出来
parameters.name: filter

parameters.help_en: The pagination token for the next query. An empty value indicates that no more results exist
parameters.help_zh: 下一个查询开始的Token，NextToken为空表示没有下一个
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page for a paged query.    

Maximum value: 100.    
Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页行数。    

最大值：100。    
默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The organizational unit (OU) in the AD domain to which the user belongs. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/311259.html to obtain this value
parameters.help_zh: 指定用户所属的AD域组织单元（OU）。可通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/311259.html接口获取
parameters.name: ou_path

parameters.help_en: This field is not available for use. You can only pass in `1` or leave it empty
parameters.help_zh: 该字段未开放使用。只能传入`1`或者不传入任何值
parameters.name: assigned_info

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return only users who have been assigned cloud computers
parameters.help_zh: 是否只返回分配云电脑的用户
parameters.name: include_assigned_user

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next query. An empty value indicates that no more results exist
NextToken.description_zh: 下一个查询开始的Token，NextToken为空表示没有下一个

Users.description_en: The array of usernames in the AD directory. If the AD directory contains only the Administrator and Guest users and no other users, an empty Users array is returned
Users.description_zh: AD目录对应的用户名称组成的数组。如果AD目录对应的用户只有Administrator和Guest，而没有其他用户，将返回空的Users数组

items.description_en: The user object in the AD directory
items.description_zh: AD目录对应的用户名称对象

AssignedDesktopNumber.description_en: The number of assigned cloud computers

DisplayNameNew.description_en: The new display name of the user
